name: adr
description: Architecture decision records in MADR format, registered as decisions land rather than reconstructed at closeout. A beads `decision` bead is the live record the moment a choice is made; the ADR file is what discharges it, so a decision cannot be lost between being made and being written. Ships steering for when a choice earns a record, a skill for authoring one, and the `adrs` CLI contract (MADR 4.0.0, `docs/adr/NNNN-title.md`, `adrs doctor` as the deterministic gate). Requires the `adrs` binary; degrades to advisory when it is absent.
